baseline_observations: All five baseline runs selected create_thread and minimal context.
All five assumed create_thread could directly create a named branch, which is not supported by the exposed tool schema.
All five omitted a durable parent-child registry and idempotent recovery protocol.
All five relied on an informal summary instead of a versioned handoff schema and parent acknowledgement.
A real collaborative child auto-committed and submitted final after its first implementation turn because commit was an acceptance criterion and no explicit-close gate existed.
A runtime exposed Codex App task capabilities only through namespaced or deferred tools; exact bare-name checks incorrectly reported all task tools missing.

forward_test_results.full_workflow: 5/5 selected create_thread with a worktree, minimal context, local binding, versioned handoff, parent acceptance, and reconciliation before retry.
forward_test_results.observed_gap: Exact create_thread argument nesting and canonical submitted status drifted when only documented in a reference file.
forward_test_results.refinement: Promoted the exact create_thread JSON shape and handoff_submitted invariant into SKILL.md.
forward_test_results.focused_retest: 2/2 returned the exact target shape, handoff_submitted status, and awaiting_parent_review reconcile issue.
forward_test_results.collaborative_v2_first_turn: 5/5 kept the child active, used checkpoint only, and explicitly avoided git add, commit, request-close, and final.
forward_test_results.collaborative_v2_close_turn: The same 5/5 agents received 收子任务 in a second turn and then used request-close, finalizing, final verification, close-phase commit, and final handoff without self-acceptance.
forward_test_results.public_release_hardening: Independent review found five release blockers. The CLI now prevents managed-state bypass, reviews only the latest final handoff, records pending clientThreadId and real hostId, separates protocol and worktree roots, and serializes state mutations with thread and process locks. Twenty regression tests pass.
